method.nearStop: a stop within a quarter mile (1,320 ft) of the school in a straight line
method.schoolPoint: the door in data/school-case/dropoff.json where the school has one (point door), else out/school-hour-crashes/schools.json (point repo)
method.serviceDate: the last Wednesday inside the feed's calendar, with the services running that day
method.window: 45 minutes before the earliest bell to 45 minutes after the latest
method.arrival: each trip once per window, at the near stop closest to the school; times truncated to the minute; tripsByRoute counts those trips
method.bells: the school's own start and dismissal from data/school-case/dropoff.json (bellSource school); else SFUSD's published start and end times (bellSource sfusd, with bellYear); else a placeholder 8:00 AM start and 3:00 PM end (bellSource placeholder), which is not the school's bell
method.shapes: the most-used shape per route and direction among those trips, simplified to 30 ft
method.arrivals: route -> direction_id -> stop_id -> arrival times HH:MM
